phases.title: Phase 1: Notes storage and add command

tasks.title: Create the notes table
tasks.body: Define a `notes` table with columns: `id` (primary key, auto-increment), `body` (text, not null), `created_at` (timestamp, defaults to now). Add it as a migration or schema setup script that can be run against a fresh database.
tasks.acceptance: Running the migration or setup on an empty database creates the `notes` table with the listed columns. Running it a second time doesn't fail or create a duplicate table.

tasks.title: Implement the add command
tasks.body: Add a command (for example `notes add "text"`) that inserts a new row into `notes` with the given body. Reject empty or whitespace-only input with a clear error message and a non-zero exit code.
tasks.acceptance: `notes add "hello"` inserts one row with body 'hello' and a created_at timestamp, and prints a confirmation that includes the new id. `notes add ""` inserts nothing and exits with an error.

tasks.title: Test the add command
tasks.body: Write automated tests for the add command against a temporary or in-memory database. Cover a valid insert, empty input, and multiple inserts in a row.
tasks.acceptance: The tests pass locally. They check the row count and stored body after each insert, and check that empty input is rejected.

tasks.title: Add a query for listing notes
tasks.body: Write a function that returns all notes, newest first (ordered by created_at descending, then by id descending as a tiebreaker).
tasks.acceptance: With 3 notes inserted, the function returns all 3 in newest-first order. With no notes, it returns an empty list.

tasks.title: Build the list page
tasks.body: Create a page (route `/notes`) that uses the list query to show each note's body and created_at. Show a friendly message such as 'No notes yet' when there are no notes. Escape note text so HTML in a note isn't rendered as markup.
tasks.acceptance: Visiting `/notes` shows every stored note, newest first. An empty database shows the empty-state message. A note containing `x` appears as literal text.

tasks.title: Test the list page
tasks.body: Write a test that seeds a few notes, requests `/notes`, and checks the response. Include an empty-state test.
tasks.acceptance: The tests pass. They confirm a 200 status, that every seeded note body appears in newest-first order, and that the empty-state message appears when there are no notes.
